company.name: Armilla AI
company.shortDescription: Armilla AI is a governance platform that enables algorithmic accountability to drive ethical decisions with transparency.
company.description:
Armilla AI is a governance platform that enables algorithmic accountability to drive ethical decisions with transparency.

The platform utilizes algorithmic accountability for tracking and governance and allows models to be tested in a matter of hours, vetting both the models themselves and the underlying datasets, helping clients by providing continuous monitoring of ongoing performance, accuracy, and algorithmic accountability by detecting errors.
